coverage: The companion shared service used before revenue engineering, when a company still has to establish that anyone wants what it sells.
detail: Demand Engineering AI Workforce is the service we run when revenue engineering would be premature. Its portfolio record sets out the work and the gate a company has to clear to graduate out of it.
The mark is used on that record and alongside Revenue Engineering AI Workforce in Studios materials. It has been in use since 2026.
